tagline: Representing the interests of inland shipping, insurance, ship's survey and related sectors across Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: In 2024, the association welcomed 225 participants from 11 countries at its annual congress in Frankfurt, demonstrating the engagement and relevance of its platform within the European inland shipping sector.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the main annual IVR Congress gathering industry stakeholders.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual congress in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, representing a broad audience from the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Strong engagement from 11 European countries demonstrating association relevance

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp, covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in inland navigation.
kpis.description: The inaugural loss prevention colloquium gathered approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany on November 4, 2024.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new recurring event focused on loss prevention expertise

kpis.name: Member Countries Represented
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with active membership or representation in the association.
kpis.description: The association represents the interests of 11 different European countries in the inland shipping sector and related sectors.
kpis.signal: Pan-European scope demonstrating cross-border coordination in inland shipping

kpis.name: Technical Information Sheets Published
kpis.explanation: Number of new technical guidance documents and information sheets issued to the industry during the reporting year.
kpis.description: Several new technical information sheets were published to provide the industry with updated and relevant information, notably through CESNI committee work.
kpis.signal: Continuous knowledge dissemination through technical standardization work
